name: Regular home cleaning
short: Weekly or fortnightly cleans that keep your home on top form, to a checklist agreed with you.
imageAlt: Illustrated living room with a sofa, rug and coffee table, freshly tidied
seoTitle: Regular House Cleaning in Guildford | Karis Smart Cleaning
metaDescription: Weekly, fortnightly or monthly house cleaning across Guildford, Godalming, Woking and nearby villages. One agreed checklist, done properly every visit. Get a free quote.
lede: A steady routine that keeps your home feeling looked after, agreed with you once and done properly every visit.
intro: Life in Surrey is busy. A regular clean takes the weekly jobs off your list, so evenings and weekends are yours again. We agree a checklist with you at the start, then work through it on every visit, room by room.
Choose weekly, fortnightly or monthly visits. If your needs change, say a guest room that needs attention before visitors, just tell us and we will adjust the plan.
idealFor: Anyone who would value a hand keeping on top of things at home

items: Worktops, splashbacks and cupboard fronts wiped
Hob surface and appliance exteriors cleaned
Sink and taps cleaned and polished
Toilet, basin, bath and shower cleaned
Beds made, with fresh linen if left out
Light switches and door handles wiped

faqs.a: Weekly, fortnightly or monthly. Tell us your preferred day and how often you would like a visit when you request a quote.

faqs.q: Can I change the checklist later?
faqs.a: Yes. The checklist is yours. Tell us what you would like added, skipped or prioritised and we will update it for future visits.
Let us know your preference when you request a quote, whether you would like us to bring products and equipment or use your own, and we will confirm it in your quote.

name: Deep cleaning
short: A one-off, top-to-bottom reset for the corners, limescale and build-up a routine clean does not reach.
imageAlt: Illustrated kitchen with an island, hob and sink, shown in clean natural light
seoTitle: Deep Cleaning in Guildford | Karis Smart Cleaning
metaDescription: One-off deep cleaning for homes in Guildford and nearby villages: limescale, skirting boards, behind furniture and inside appliances on request. Free quote.
lede: A thorough, top-to-bottom clean that resets your home, ideal before a regular routine starts, after a busy season or ahead of a special occasion.
intro: A deep clean goes well beyond the weekly basics. We take the time to clear limescale from taps and shower screens, wash down skirting boards and door frames, clean behind and under furniture we can safely move, and bring kitchens and bathrooms back to their best.
Many people book a deep clean as a fresh start before regular cleaning begins, before guests arrive, or simply when the house needs more than a quick tidy.
idealFor: Homes that have not had a professional clean for a while
Getting ready for guests, a celebration or a sale
A fresh start before regular cleaning begins

items: Inside the oven and fridge on request
Limescale removed from taps, shower heads and screens
Toilet cleaned thoroughly, including the base and behind
Skirting boards, door frames and doors washed
Window sills and interior glass cleaned
Floors vacuumed and mopped edge to edge

faqs.q: How long does a deep clean take?
faqs.a: It depends on the size and condition of the property. We will give you a realistic estimate with your quote, so you know what to expect on the day.

faqs.q: Can I book a deep clean and then switch to regular cleaning?
faqs.a: Yes. Many people start with a deep clean so that regular visits can maintain the standard from then on. Mention it when you request a quote.
We clean behind and under furniture that can be moved safely. For heavy or fragile items, we will talk it through with you first.

name: End of tenancy cleaning
short: A detailed move-out or move-in clean for tenants, landlords and letting agents, from cupboards to skirting.
imageAlt: Illustrated empty bedroom with moving boxes, ready for a move-out clean
seoTitle: End of Tenancy Cleaning Guildford | Karis Smart Cleaning
metaDescription: End of tenancy cleaning in Guildford, Godalming and Woking for tenants, landlords and agents. Inside cupboards, appliances, bathrooms and floors. Free quote.
h1: End of tenancy cleaning in Guildford
lede: A detailed clean of an empty property, so you can hand over the keys with confidence, or move into a home that is properly ready for you.
intro: Moving is stressful enough. Our end of tenancy clean covers the areas move-out inspections typically focus on: inside cupboards and drawers, inside the oven, hob and extractor, the fridge, bathrooms, skirting boards, doors and floors.

We work for tenants, landlords and letting agents across Guildford and the surrounding area, including student lets near the University of Surrey. We cannot decide what a landlord or agent will accept, but we will clean to a detailed checklist and you are welcome to walk through it with us.
idealFor: Tenants moving out and preparing for a check-out inspection
Landlords and letting agents between tenancies
Buyers and tenants moving into a new home

items: Inside the oven, hob and extractor
Fridge and freezer inside and out (defrosted beforehand)
Floors including edges and under appliances where accessible
Limescale removed from taps, screens and tiles
Toilet, basin, bath and shower deep cleaned
Skirting boards, doors and door frames
Interior window glass, frames and sills
Carpets vacuumed and hard floors mopped

faqs.q: Does the property need to be empty?
faqs.a: Ideally, yes. An empty property lets us clean inside every cupboard and along every edge. If some furniture is staying, let us know when you request a quote.

faqs.q: Do I need to defrost the fridge?
faqs.a: Please switch off and defrost the fridge and freezer before the clean, so we can clean them properly inside.

faqs.q: Can you work with my letting agent?
faqs.a: Yes. If your agent has a check-out checklist or inventory notes, send them over with your quote request and we will work to them.

items: Combined with a regular or deep clean

faqs.a: Access varies from property to property. Tell us about your home when you request a quote and we will confirm which windows we can safely clean.

faqs.q: Can I combine window cleaning with a house clean?
faqs.a: Yes. Many people add windows to a deep clean or an end of tenancy clean so everything is done in one visit.

faqs.q: How often should windows be cleaned?
faqs.a: Every four to eight weeks suits most homes, but it depends on your location and preferences. We are happy to clean as a one-off too.
